title: Cogni multi-repo sync manifest (inverse form v2)
description: spec.repo-sync-contract — inverse manifest: declares global excludes + per-artifact divergences (omit_from_artifact + artifact_only). Anything else under hub is expected to mirror 1:1 across all artifacts. Mirrors the CATALOG_IS_SSOT pattern (infra/catalog/_schema.json).

node_local.description: Tier 3 (node identity / presentation) globs — homepage, landing UI, branding/theme, repo-spec, persona. Carved OUT of the node-template→fork Tier-2 substrate merge: node-template is a starter only, so its presentation NEVER overwrites a fork's (spec.repo-sync-contract THREE_TIER_CARVE_OUT). Read at runtime by the operator fork-sync from node-template's copy of this manifest (TIER3_IS_DATA). Distinct axis from divergences[] (hub↔artifact drift).

schema.description: Manifest schema version. Bump = lock-step PRs across all repos per MANIFEST_BOOTSTRAP.

hub.description: GitHub owner/repo of the canonical hub. Per HUB_IS_COGNI_MONOREPO this is cogni-dao/cogni.

visibility.description: public = anonymous clone OK in detector; private = needs PAT (detector skips in v0.1).

role.description: What this artifact IS to the hub. `fork` (default) = a downstream artifact that carries its own node body. `test-parent` = a near-1:1 CI/CD mirror of the hub whose ONLY sanctioned differences are declared test identity, fixture roster/pins, and environment-specific desired state (spec.repo-sync-contract TEST_PARENT_IS_NEAR_IDENTICAL). Consumed by scripts/ci/sync-test-parent.mjs to pick its target — never a second hardcoded owner/repo.

on_missing.description: What an UNDECLARED missing-on-artifact path means. `report` (default) = drift is data; the detector exits 0 and the tracking issue carries it. `fail` = the detector exits non-zero. A test parent sets `fail`: a canonical path the hub generates and the mirror lacks is not a report, it is a broken generator input (task.5142 — the absent infra/k8s/overlays/<env>/scheduler-worker/node-endpoints.patch.yaml that 422'd spawny-boi env activation).

exclude.description: Global glob excludes — never propagated to or from any artifact. Junk/caches/build outputs.

omit_from_artifact.description: Globs of paths the hub has but this artifact MUST NOT carry.

artifact_only.description: Globs of paths the artifact has but the hub MUST NOT carry.

content_may_differ.description: Globs of paths that MUST EXIST on both sides but whose CONTENT is legitimately per-deployment (identity, roster-generated desired state). Suppresses the content check only — a missing path is still drift, so a generated canonical path can never go silently absent. TAKES PRECEDENCE over omit_from_artifact, so a broad roster omission can re-require the control-plane rows inside it. Replaces the v1 twin-listing workaround (the same glob in omit_from_artifact AND artifact_only), which zeroed the flag in both directions and therefore hid absence too.
